sentences.text: Dapingfangornis was a small to medium-sized animal.
Its breastbone, known as the sternum, featured both long and short lateral processes.
The bird possessed a unique thorn-like process located on its nostrils.
Fossils of this species were discovered in the Jiufotang Formation in Liaoning province, China.
The genus Dapingfangornis was described by Li and colleagues in 2006.
It is an extinct avialan belonging to the Enantiornithes clade.
Dapingfangornis is assigned to the family Longipterygidae and also classified within the family Eoenantiornithidae.
The Paleobiology Database lists Eoenantiornithidae as the parent group for Dapingfangornis.
The Paleobiology Database classifies Dapingfangornis under the class Reptilia.
This bird lived during the Early Cretaceous period.
Fossil evidence dates the genus to the Aptian stage, between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
